steps: Layer half the yogurt, granola, and berries. Repeat.

Banana Pudding:
- 1 can sweetened condensed milk
- 1 1/2 cups cold water
- 1 package instant vanilla pudding
- 3 cups heavy cream
- 1 box Nilla wafers
- 5 ripe bananas, sliced

- Whisk the milk, water, and pudding until smooth
- Chill until firm, 1–2 hours
- Whip the cream to stiff peaks and fold in the pudding
- Layer pudding, wafers, and bananas, ending with pudding
- Chill, then garnish with a few wafers
Buffalo Chicken Dip:
- 2 cans chunk chicken, drained
- 3/4 cup hot sauce
- 2 packages cream cheese, softened
- 1 cup ranch dressing
- 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar
- celery and crackers, for serving

- Heat the chicken and hot sauce, 3–5 minutes
- Stir in the cream cheese and ranch until warm
- Mix in half the cheddar and top with the rest
- Slow cooker on Low, about 35 minutes
- Serve warm

ingredients.name: fine sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Overlap the tomato, mozzarella, and basil.
Drizzle with olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.

Chipotle Mayonnaise:
- 1 cup mayonnaise
- 1 canned chipotle pepper in adobo
- 2 teaspoons adobo sauce
- 1 teaspoon lime juice
- salt

- Blend until smooth
- Keep in the fridge up to a week

steps: Stir everything together.
Roll into balls.
Freeze about 1 hour, until set. Keep in the fridge up to a week.

Garbanzo Beans:
- 1 pound dried chickpeas
- salt
- bay leaf, garlic, and onion

- Pick through, rinse, and soak at least 8 hours
- Cover with fresh water. Add the salt and aromatics
- Simmer 1 1/2–2 hours, until tender

ingredients.name: fukujinzuke (Japanese red pickled vegetables)
ingredients.note: optional; or make my Homemade Fukujinzuke

steps: Cut the onions into wedges, the carrots into chunks, and the potatoes into quarters.
Grate the ginger, garlic, and apple. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces.
Cook the onions in the oil about 5 minutes, until tender.
Add the garlic and ginger, then the chicken, until the outside is no longer pink.
Add the stock, apple, honey, soy sauce, ketchup, carrots, and potatoes.
Simmer until the carrots and potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Skim the foam.
Turn off the heat. Dissolve the curry roux in a ladle of the liquid, then stir it in.
Simmer 5–10 minutes, until thick.
Serve with rice.

Mexican Rice:
- 2 tablespoons oil
- 1/2 large onion, chopped
- 2 cups long grain rice
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 can diced tomatoes and green chiles
- 1 can whole tomatoes
- 2 cups chicken broth
- 1 teaspoon cumin
- 1 teaspoon salt
- cilantro

- Cook the onion 3–4 minutes
- Add the rice and garlic and cook 3 minutes
- Stir in the tomatoes and cook 2 minutes
- Add the broth, salt, and cumin. Boil, then cover and simmer 10–15 minutes
- Top with cilantro
Pickles:
- 1 1/4 cups distilled white vinegar
- 3 tablespoons kosher salt
- 2 tablespoons sugar
- 2 cups cold water
- 1 3/4–2 pounds Kirby cucumbers, halved or speared
- 2 tablespoons coriander seeds
- 6 garlic cloves, halved
- 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
- 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes
- 16 dill sprigs

- Heat the vinegar, salt, and sugar until dissolved. Stir in the cold water and chill
- Pack the cucumbers, spices, and brine into two quart jars
- Refrigerate about 24 hours
- Keeps about 1 month
Pizza:
- 2 teaspoons yeast
- 7/8–1 1/8 cups lukewarm water
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 3 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/4 teaspoons salt

- If using active dry yeast, dissolve it in 2 tablespoons of the water until foamy, about 15 minutes
- Mix and knead into a soft dough, about 4–5 minutes
- Rise until puffy, about 1 hour for instant yeast or 90 minutes for active dry
- Shape, top, and bake
Sloppy Joes:
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1/2 cup minced carrots
- 1 cup chopped onion
- 1/2 cup chopped celery
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 1/4 pounds ground beef
- 1/2 cup ketchup
- 2 cups tomato sauce
- 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
- 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
- 1 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar
- pinch cloves, 1/2 teaspoon thyme, pinch cayenne, salt and pepper
- 4 hamburger buns

- Cook the carrots in the oil 5 minutes. Add the onion and celery for 5 minutes more, then the garlic for 30 seconds
- Brown the beef. Leave about 1 tablespoon of fat
- Stir in the ketchup, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, vinegar, brown sugar, and spices
- Simmer on medium-low for 10 minutes
- Serve on the buns
Baked Sweet Potato (Vegan):
- sweet potatoes

Baked
- Poke holes with a fork
- Oven: 425 degrees
- Time: 40–50 minutes
- Serve with toppings

ingredients.name: soy sauce, tamari, or liquid aminos
cloves minced garlic (optional and to taste)
large or 4 small portobello mushroom caps, stems trimmed and gills removed
small eggplant or 1 baby eggplant, sliced crosswise into 1/2 inch slices
large or 2 small red bell peppers, cut into 2-inch strips
large or 2 small red onions, sliced crosswise into 1/2-inch slices

steps: Whisk the marinade.
Marinate the vegetables at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Grill over medium-high, 6–10 minutes, turning until tender.
Or roast at 425 degrees for 25–35 minutes, flipping halfway.
Pile onto toasted buns.

Buffalo Cauliflower Wings (Vegan):
- 2/3 cup flour
- 1/4 cup cornstarch
- 1 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1 teaspoon onion powder
- 1 teaspoon paprika
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 3/4 cup water
- 1 cauliflower, in large florets
- buffalo sauce

Baked
- Whisk the dry ingredients and water. Coat the florets
- Oven: 450 degrees
- Time: 10 minutes, flip, then 10 minutes more
- Brush with buffalo sauce
- Time: 12–15 minutes more, until crisp

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.note: sliced into squares, plus more for greasing the baking dish

steps: Butter a 9x13.
Peel and slice the sweet potatoes 1/2 inch thick.
Melt the butter with the sugars, spices, and salt. Stir in the vanilla.
Coat the potatoes with the syrup.
Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.
Uncover, toss, and bake 30–40 minutes more, until tender and syrupy.

ingredients.name: large egg (50 g each w/o shell)
chicken stock/broth
ingredients.note: for vegan/vegetarian, use vegetable broth or Vegan Dashi

ingredients.name: ponzu
ingredients.note: or make my Homemade Ponzu recipe

ingredients.name: cooked Japanese short-grain rice
ingredients.note: or precooked udon / ramen noodles; for the final course

steps: Mix the chicken, egg, scallion, ginger, soy sauce, panko, and cornstarch. Roll into 1-inch meatballs.
Cut the chicken, cod, tofu, pork, cabbage, carrot, negi, scallions, and mushrooms into bite-size pieces. Peel the shrimp.
Simmer the stock, sake, mirin, garlic, and ginger.
Dissolve the miso in a little broth, stir it back in, and take the pot off the heat before it boils.
Simmer the fish, tofu, cabbage, negi, carrots, and mushrooms about 10 minutes.
Add the meatballs and remaining meat and vegetables. Simmer about 10 minutes more.
Serve with ponzu or sesame sauce. Finish the broth with rice or noodles for 2–3 minutes.

ingredients.name: large egg (50 g each w/o shell)
chicken stock/broth
ingredients.note: for vegan/vegetarian, use vegetable broth or Vegan Dashi

ingredients.name: ponzu
ingredients.note: or make my Homemade Ponzu recipe

ingredients.name: cooked Japanese short-grain rice
ingredients.note: or precooked udon / ramen noodles; for the final course

steps: Mix the chicken, egg, scallion, ginger, soy sauce, panko, and cornstarch. Roll into 1-inch meatballs.
Cut the chicken, cod, tofu, pork, cabbage, carrot, negi, scallions, and mushrooms into bite-size pieces. Peel the shrimp.
Simmer the stock, sake, mirin, garlic, and ginger.
Dissolve the miso in a little broth, stir it back in, and take the pot off the heat before it boils.
Simmer the fish, tofu, cabbage, negi, carrots, and mushrooms about 10 minutes.
Add the meatballs and remaining meat and vegetables. Simmer about 10 minutes more.
Serve with ponzu or sesame sauce. Finish the broth with rice or noodles for 2–3 minutes.

ingredients.name: fine-grain sea salt and black pepper, to taste
water (or 4 cups vegetable broth + 2 cups water)
kale, de-stemmed and torn in pieces
ce from 1/2 of a small lemon (or a whole lemon, depending how much lemon flavor you prefer)

steps: Cook the onion and garlic in a little water for 2 minutes.
Add the celery, carrots, broccoli, tomatoes, and ginger. Cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the turmeric, cinnamon, cayenne, salt, and pepper.
Add the rest of the water. Simmer 10–15 minutes, until the vegetables are soft.
Add the kale, cabbage, and lemon juice for the last 2–3 minutes.

ingredients.name: noodles
ingredients.note: cellophane, ramen, udon, or soba 5.3 oz

steps: Pour the hot oil over the garlic and ginger. Stir in the curry paste, parsley, tahini, and soy sauce.
Boil the noodles. Add the bok choy for the last 2 minutes. Save the cooking water.
Cook the dumplings until tender.
Whisk about 3 cups of the hot water into the flavor base. Add more to taste.
Divide the noodles, bok choy, and dumplings. Pour on the broth and add toppings.

Fermented Beets:
- enough beets to fill a quart jar
- 1 tablespoon mustard seeds
- 1 tablespoon salt per cup of non-chlorinated water

- Peel and slice the beets
- Pack the jar, leaving 1–1 1/2 inches of headspace. Add the mustard seeds
- Dissolve the salt in water and pour it over the beets. Keep them submerged
- Ferment at room temperature a few days, until bubbly. Burp the jar daily if it is sealed tight
Flour Tortillas:
- 3 cups flour
- 1 teaspoon kosher salt
- 1 1/4 teaspoons baking powder
- 1 cup just-boiled water
- 1/3 cup melted butter

- Mix the flour, salt, and baking powder
- Stir in the butter and water until no dry flour remains
- Knead about 30 seconds. Rest, covered, 15 minutes
- Divide into 8–10 pieces and roll them thin
- Cook in a dry pan over medium-low, about 2 minutes a side, until bubbles form

steps: Whisk the half-and-half, egg, vanilla, salt, and cinnamon.
Soak each side of the bread for 2 minutes.
Cook in butter over medium heat, 4 minutes, then 3–4 minutes on the other side.
Serve with maple syrup.
Season the chicken with oregano, paprika, salt, and red pepper flakes.
Cook in olive oil about 5 minutes a side, until 165 degrees. Set aside.
Cook half the tomatoes with the garlic, oregano, and salt about 2 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts, then the rice, chickpeas, lemon juice, and remaining tomatoes.
Toss the feta with olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano. Stir half into the rice.
Add the chicken and top with the rest of the feta.
Toss the chicken with the cornstarch.
Whisk the honey, broth, soy sauce, vinegar, and garlic powder.
Sear the chicken in oil over medium-high, 3–5 minutes a side. Work in batches.
Off the heat, add the sauce. Return the chicken and cook on medium until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked through.

Kvass (Probiotic Drink):
- 1 pound fresh fruit or fruit scraps
- 1/4 cup sugar
- 3–4 cups water

- Put the fruit in a clean jar
- Dissolve the sugar in the water and pour it over the fruit
- Ferment at room temperature 1–4 days, stirring daily
- Refrigerate
Naan:
- 2 cups flour
- 1 tablespoon sugar
- 1 teaspoon instant yeast
- 1 teaspoon salt
- 3 tablespoons plain yogurt
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 3/4 cup warm water
- 2 tablespoons melted butter

- Mix the dry ingredients
- Stir in the yogurt, oil, and water. Knead just until it comes together
- Rise until doubled, 1–1 1/2 hours
- Divide into pieces, roll thin, and cook in a hot dry pan until blistered
- Brush with butter

ingredients.name: bone-in chicken pieces
ingredients.note: I used a fryer pack, 8 pieces total.

steps: Warm the pickle juice, dissolve the sugar, and brine the chicken at least 1 hour.
Mix the buttermilk and hot sauce. Mix the flour, cornstarch, and creole seasoning.
Coat in flour, then buttermilk, then flour again.
Heat the oil to 350 degrees. Fry in batches 7–8 minutes, until 165 inside.
Hold the fried chicken at 250 degrees.
Stir the cayenne, paprika, brown sugar, chili powder, garlic powder, and salt into 3/4 cup of the fry oil.
Brush the spicy oil on the chicken. Serve on white bread with pickles.

Oven Baked Catfish (Blue Catfish Filet):
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 2 pounds catfish fillets
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
- 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
- 2 teaspoons parsley
- 2 tablespoons chives
- 2 tablespoons butter
- 4 tablespoons dry white wine

Baked
- Oil the pan. Season both sides of the fish
- Top with the herbs, butter, and wine
- Oven: 350 degrees
- Time: 20 minutes

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: Chicken Stock or Vegetable Broth would also work

steps: Rinse the quinoa.
Boil the quinoa, water, and salt.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes, until the liquid is gone.
Rest, covered, 10 minutes. Fluff and serve.

ingredients.name: chipotle en adobo sauce
ingredients.note: or more if you want it spicy

ingredients.name: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
* For gluten-free be sure to check the labels.

steps: Cook the quinoa in 1 3/4 cups broth.
Cook the garlic in the oil 1–2 minutes. Add the tomato sauce, salt, cumin, broth, and chipotle. Simmer 3–4 minutes.
Mix the quinoa, chiles, corn, beans, cilantro, and 1/2 cup of the cheese.
Spread in a greased 9x12. Top with the sauce and the rest of the cheese.
Cover. Oven: 400 degrees. Time: 20–25 minutes.
Top with avocado, scallions, and cilantro.
Place the salmon skin-side down. Brush with butter and season with salt, pepper, and garlic.
Oven: 375 degrees. Time: about 12 minutes, until 125 inside.
Broil 3–4 minutes, until the top is lightly golden.
Garnish with parsley, dill, and the lemon.
Whisk the eggs, milk, brown sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt.
Soak the bread on both sides.
Cook in butter over medium-low, about 3 minutes, then 2 minutes on the other side.
Hold the finished slices in a 195 degree oven while you cook the rest.

Spinach Patties:
- 16 1/2 ounces spinach
- 4 ounces goat cheese or feta
- 2 eggs
- 1/2 cup matzo meal
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon pepper
- oil, for frying
- 4 tablespoons olive oil
- 1 1/2 cups chicken stock
- juice of 2 lemons
- 7 garlic cloves, minced
- 3 bunches cilantro

- Steam the spinach until wilted. Drain and chop
- Mix with the cheese, eggs, matzo meal, salt, and pepper
- Fry patties in a little oil over medium-high until browned
- Simmer the olive oil, stock, lemon juice, garlic, and cilantro, and spoon it over the patties

ingredients.name: cooked beans
ingredients.note: black, kidney, pinto, white beans, or combination

steps: Rinse canned beans.
Heat the beans, tomatoes, bulgur, and taco seasoning. If the bulgur is raw, add 1/2 cup water and cook until tender.
Chop the vegetables.
Fill the tortillas and add salsa or sauce.
For shells, drape the tortillas over the oven rack. Oven: 400 degrees. Time: 5–7 minutes.
Cover the bones with cold water, boil 15–20 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Roast the bones and vegetables at 450 degrees for 30 minutes. Toss and roast 15–30 minutes more.
Cover with water. Add the bay leaves, peppercorns, star anise, cinnamon, and vinegar.
Simmer with the lid ajar at least 8–12 hours, up to 24. Keep everything submerged.
Strain, cool, and lift off the fat.
Refrigerate about 5 days, or freeze up to 6 months.
Cook the celery and carrots in the butter for 3 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the stock, rosemary, thyme, red pepper, salt, and pepper. Add bouillon if it needs more chicken flavor.
Boil, add the noodles, and cook until just tender.
Stir in the chicken and adjust the seasoning.

Mayonnaise:
- 1 cup light-flavored oil
- 1 large egg, room temperature
- 1 garlic clove, minced
- 1 teaspoon lemon juice
- 2 teaspoons mustard powder
- salt

- Pour the oil into a jar. Crack in the egg and let it sink
- Blend on the yolk until the bottom turns creamy, then move the blender through the jar until it emulsifies
- Blend in the garlic, lemon juice, mustard powder, and salt
Baked Sweet and Sour Chicken:
- 1 1/2 pounds chicken, bite-size
- 1/3 cup cornstarch
- 1 bell pepper, chunked
- 1 cup pineapple chunks
- 1/3 cup pineapple juice
- 3 tablespoons ketchup
- 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce
- 2 tablespoons brown sugar
- 1 teaspoon garlic

Baked
- Toss the chicken with cornstarch
- Oven: 400 degrees
- Time: 20 minutes, flip halfway
- Simmer the sauce ingredients until thick
- Toss the chicken, pepper, and pineapple with the sauce
Beet Smoothie:
- 1 small cooked beet
- 1 banana
- 1 cup frozen berries
- 1 cup milk or yogurt
- 1 teaspoon grated ginger
- honey, to taste

- Blend until smooth
Black Beans:
- 1 pound dried black beans
- salt
- bay leaf, garlic, and onion

- Pick through, rinse, and soak at least 8 hours
- Cover with a few inches of water. Add the salt and aromatics
- Boil, then simmer 60–90 minutes, until tender
Broccoli Cheese Chowder:
- 2 tablespoons butter
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 tablespoons flour
- 3 cups broth
- 2 cups diced potato
- 4 cups broccoli florets
- 1 cup milk
- 2 cups shredded cheddar
- salt and pepper

- Cook the onion in the butter. Stir in the flour
- Add the broth and potato. Simmer until the potato is tender
- Add the broccoli and cook until just tender
- Stir in the milk and cheese until melted
Broccoli Feta Soup:
- 1 onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic
- 6 cups broccoli florets
- 4 cups broth
- 4 ounces feta
- salt and pepper

- Cook the onion and garlic
- Add the broccoli and broth. Simmer until the broccoli is soft
- Blend with the feta. Season
Brownie Cookies:
- 1/2 cup butter
- 1 cup sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 teaspoon vanilla
- 1/2 cup cocoa
- 1 cup flour
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1 cup chocolate chips

Baked
- Mix the butter, sugar, eggs, and vanilla
- Stir in the cocoa, flour, salt, and chips
- Oven: 350 degrees
- Time: 8–10 minutes
Burger and Fries:
- 1 pound ground beef
- salt and pepper
- 4 buns
- cheese, optional
- 2 large potatoes
- 1 tablespoon oil

- Cut the potatoes into fries. Toss with oil, salt, and pepper
- Oven: 425 degrees
- Time: 25–30 minutes, flip halfway
- Salt the beef and form 4 thin patties
- Cook in a hot skillet, about 3 minutes a side. Add cheese and serve on the buns
Cauliflower:
- 1 cauliflower, in florets
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- salt and pepper

Baked
- Toss the florets with oil, salt, and pepper
- Oven: 425 degrees
- Time: 20–25 minutes, until browned
Cheese-Wrapped Chicken Taquitos:
- 2 cups shredded cooked chicken
- 1/2 teaspoon chili powder
- 1/2 teaspoon cumin
- salt
- 8 slices cheese, or cheese slices large enough to wrap

Baked
- Mix the chicken and spices
- Spoon onto the cheese and roll into taquitos
- Oven: 400 degrees
- Time: 10–12 minutes, until the cheese is crisp
Chicken Salad:
- 2 cups cooked chicken, chopped
- 1/2 cup mayonnaise
- 1 rib celery, diced
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard
- salt and pepper
- fresh herbs, optional

- Stir everything together
- Chill
Chicken Tikka Masala:
- 1 1/2 pounds chicken, bite-size
- 1/2 cup yogurt
- 1 tablespoon garam masala
- 1 teaspoon cumin
- 1 onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic
- 1 tablespoon grated ginger
- 1 can tomato sauce
- 1/2 cup cream
- salt

- Toss the chicken with the yogurt, garam masala, and cumin
- Cook the onion, garlic, and ginger. Add the tomato sauce
- Add the chicken. Simmer until cooked through, about 20 minutes
- Stir in the cream. Serve with rice
Chicken Tortilla Casserole:
- 3 cups shredded cooked chicken
- 1 can enchilada sauce
- 1 can black beans, drained
- 1 cup corn
- 8 corn tortillas, cut into strips
- 2 cups shredded cheese

Baked
- Stir the chicken, sauce, beans, and corn
- Layer with the tortillas and half the cheese in a greased 9x13
- Top with the rest of the cheese
- Oven: 350 degrees
- Time: 25 minutes
Chili for Hot Dogs/Hamburgers:
- 1 pound ground beef
- 1 small onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic
- 2 tablespoons chili powder
- 1 teaspoon cumin
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 1/2 cup water
- salt

- Brown the beef and onion. Drain
- Add the garlic, chili powder, and cumin
- Stir in the tomato sauce and water
- Simmer 20 minutes. Serve on hot dogs or burgers
Chocolate Mousse:
- 6 ounces chocolate, chopped
- 1 1/2 cups cold heavy cream
- 1 tablespoon sugar
- pinch salt

- Melt the chocolate and let it cool slightly
- Whip the cream and sugar to soft peaks
- Fold the chocolate into the cream
- Chill at least 1 hour
Chocolate Peanut Butter Balls:
- 1 cup peanut butter
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar
- 2 tablespoons butter, softened
- 1 cup chocolate chips
- 1 teaspoon oil

- Mix the peanut butter, sugar, and butter. Roll into balls
- Chill 30 minutes
- Melt the chocolate with the oil and coat the balls
- Chill until set
Cinnamon Roll Bread:
- 3 cups flour
- 2 1/4 teaspoons yeast
- 1 cup warm milk
- 1/4 cup sugar
- 1/4 cup butter, melted
- 1 egg
- 1 teaspoon salt
- 1/3 cup brown sugar
- 1 tablespoon cinnamon

Baked
- Mix the flour, yeast, milk, sugar, butter, egg, and salt into a soft dough
- Rise until doubled, about 1 hour
- Roll out, spread with brown sugar and cinnamon, and roll up
- Rise 30 minutes in a loaf pan
- Oven: 350 degrees
- Time: 30–35 minutes
Coleslaw:
- 4 cups shredded cabbage
- 1 carrot, shredded
- 1/3 cup mayonnaise
- 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar
- 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard
- 1 teaspoon sugar or honey
- salt and pepper

- Whisk the dressing
- Toss with the cabbage and carrot
- Chill 30 minutes
Crustless Quiche:
Vegetable
- 6 eggs
- 1/2 cup milk
- 6–8 cooked breakfast sausage links, sliced
- 8 ounces Swiss or Gruyere
- half a pack of arugula
- 2–3 cloves garlic
- 1 small onion, sliced
- 8 ounces chopped portobello mushrooms
- salt and pepper
- butter

- Cook the sausage and slice it. Cool
- Sauté the onion and mushrooms in butter. Add the garlic and a pinch of salt
- Stir in the arugula until it wilts. Cool
- Whisk the eggs, milk, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and pepper
- Put the vegetables and sausage in a greased 9-inch pie dish. Add the cheese, then the eggs
- Oven: 350 degrees
- Time: 30–40 minutes, until the center is set

Bacon
- 8 eggs
- 2/3 cup milk
- 3 ounces bacon bits
- 8–12 ounces shredded cheddar
- 1/2 teaspoon salt and black pepper

- Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper
- Put the bacon and cheese in a greased 9-inch pie dish. Add the eggs
- Oven: 350 degrees
- Time: 30–40 minutes, until the center is set
Curried Butternut Squash Soup:
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic
- 1 tablespoon curry powder
- 1 butternut squash, peeled and cubed
- 4 cups broth
- 1/2 cup coconut milk
- salt

- Cook the onion and garlic. Stir in the curry powder
- Add the squash and broth. Simmer until soft
- Blend. Stir in the coconut milk
Fermented Onions:
- 2 onions, sliced
- 1 tablespoon salt
- 2 cups water
- 1 clove garlic
- peppercorns, optional

- Dissolve the salt in the water
- Pack the onions and garlic in a jar. Cover with brine and keep them submerged
- Ferment at room temperature 5–7 days. Burp the jar daily
- Refrigerate
Fermented Pickles with Garlic and Dill:
- 1 pound small cucumbers
- 3 tablespoons salt
- 1 quart water
- 4 cloves garlic
- a handful of dill

- Dissolve the salt in the water
- Pack the cucumbers, garlic, and dill in a jar. Cover with brine and keep them submerged
- Ferment at room temperature 3–7 days, until sour. Burp daily
- Refrigerate
Harissa Butter Beans:
- 2 cans butter beans, drained
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 3 cloves garlic
- 2 tablespoons harissa
- 1/2 cup coconut milk or water
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- salt
- parsley or cilantro

- Cook the garlic in the oil. Stir in the harissa
- Add the beans and coconut milk. Simmer 8–10 minutes
- Finish with lemon juice and herbs
Honey Garlic Crispy Chicken:
- 1 1/2 pounds chicken thighs
- 2 tablespoons cornstarch
- salt and pepper
- 3 tablespoons honey
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon butter

Baked
- Toss the chicken with cornstarch, salt, and pepper
- Oven: 425 degrees
- Time: 25–30 minutes, until crisp and 165 inside
- Simmer the honey, soy sauce, garlic, and butter until glossy
- Toss the chicken in the sauce
Kanji:
- 2 carrots, cut into sticks
- 1 beet, cut into sticks
- 1 tablespoon mustard seeds
- 1 tablespoon salt
- 4 cups water

- Crush the mustard seeds
- Stir the salt into the water. Add the vegetables and mustard
- Cover loosely and ferment at room temperature 3–5 days, until tangy
- Refrigerate
Kefir Water (Probiotic Drink):
- a little less than 1 cup sugar
- 3 dates
- 1 tablespoon molasses
- 2 very ripe bananas
- spring water, to fill a gallon jar
- water kefir grains

- Add the sugar, dates, molasses, and bananas to the jar
- Fill with spring water. Cover with a towel and keep it dark
- Ferment at 75 degrees for 3 days
Kombucha:
- 1 gallon water
- 1 cup sugar
- 8 bags black tea
- 1 scoby and 2 cups starter kombucha

- Boil the water and sugar. Steep the tea, then cool to room temperature
- Add the starter and scoby. Cover with a cloth
- Ferment 7–14 days, until it tastes as tart as you want
- Bottle with a little fruit or juice for 2–3 days, then refrigerate
Korean Popcorn Chicken:
- 1 pound chicken, bite-size
- 1/2 cup potato starch or cornstarch
- salt
- oil, for frying
- 2 tablespoons gochujang
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon ketchup
- 2 cloves garlic
- sesame seeds

- Toss the chicken with salt and starch
- Fry at 350 degrees until crisp, about 4–5 minutes
- Simmer the gochujang, honey, soy sauce, ketchup, and garlic
- Toss the chicken in the sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds
Lemon Squares:
- 1 cup flour
- 1/4 cup powdered sugar
- 1/2 cup butter
- 3 eggs
- 1 cup sugar
- 1/3 cup lemon juice
- 2 tablespoons flour
- powdered sugar, for the top

Baked
- Mix the crust flour, powdered sugar, and butter. Press into an 8-inch pan
- Oven: 350 degrees
- Time: 15 minutes
- Whisk the eggs, sugar, lemon juice, and flour. Pour over the crust
- Time: 20 minutes more, until set
- Cool, then dust with powdered sugar
Mashed Potato Cakes:
- 2 cups cold mashed potatoes
- 1 egg
- 1/4 cup flour
- salt and pepper
- oil or butter, for frying

- Mix the potatoes, egg, flour, salt, and pepper
- Form into cakes
- Fry in a little oil over medium, about 3–4 minutes a side, until browned
Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles:
- 8 ounces noodles
- 1 pound ground beef
- 3 cloves garlic
- 1 teaspoon grated ginger
- 1/4 cup soy sauce
- 2 tablespoons brown sugar
- 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
- 1/2 cup water
- scallions

- Cook the noodles
- Brown the beef. Add the garlic and ginger
- Stir in the soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, and water. Simmer until glossy
- Toss with the noodles and scallions
Mushroom Soup:
- 1 onion, chopped
- 1 pound mushrooms, sliced
- 3 cloves garlic
- 1/2 cup wild rice
- 4 cups broth
- 1/2 cup cream or coconut milk
- thyme, salt, and pepper

- Cook the onion and mushrooms until browned. Add the garlic
- Add the rice and broth. Simmer about 45 minutes, until the rice is tender
- Stir in the cream. Season
Pecan Pie Bars:
- 1 cup flour
- 1/3 cup brown sugar
- 1/2 cup butter
- 2 eggs
- 1/2 cup corn syrup
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 2 tablespoons butter, melted
- 1 teaspoon vanilla
- 1 1/2 cups pecans

Baked
- Mix the flour, 1/3 cup brown sugar, and butter. Press into an 8-inch pan
- Oven: 350 degrees
- Time: 12 minutes
- Whisk the eggs, corn syrup, brown sugar, melted butter, and vanilla. Stir in the pecans
- Pour over the crust
- Time: 25 minutes, until set
Philly Cheesesteak Egg Rolls:
- 1/2 pound steak, thinly sliced
- 1 onion, sliced
- 1 bell pepper, sliced
- 4 slices provolone
- 8 egg roll wrappers
- salt and pepper

Baked
- Cook the steak, onion, and pepper. Season
- Spoon into the wrappers with the cheese. Roll and seal
- Oven: 400 degrees
- Time: 15 minutes, until crisp
Pickled Red Onions:
- 1 red onion, thinly sliced
- 1/2 cup vinegar
- 1/2 cup water
- 1 tablespoon sugar
- 1 teaspoon salt

- Heat the vinegar, water, sugar, and salt until dissolved
- Pour over the onion
- Cool, then refrigerate at least 30 minutes
Quesadilla:
- 2 flour tortillas
- 1 cup shredded cheese
- cooked chicken, beans, or vegetables
- oil or butter

- Heat a skillet over medium
- Fill one tortilla with cheese and the filling. Top with the second tortilla
- Cook about 2–3 minutes a side, until the cheese melts and the outside is browned
- Cut into wedges
Quiche:
- 1 pie crust
- 4 eggs
- 1 cup cream or milk
- 4 slices cooked bacon, chopped
- 1 cup shredded cheese
- salt and pepper

Baked
- Whisk the eggs, cream, salt, and pepper
- Put the bacon and cheese in the crust. Add the eggs
- Oven: 375 degrees
- Time: 35–45 minutes, until the center is set
Salad (Vegan):
- 6 cups mixed greens
- cucumber, tomato, or other vegetables
- 3 tablespoons olive oil
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice or vinegar
- 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard
- salt and pepper

- Whisk the oil, lemon juice, mustard, salt, and pepper
- Toss with the greens and vegetables
Sauerkraut:
- 1 small cabbage, about 2 pounds
- 1 tablespoon salt

- Shred the cabbage and toss it with the salt
- Massage until it releases liquid
- Pack it into a jar until the brine covers it. Keep it submerged
- Ferment at room temperature 1–4 weeks, until sour. Burp daily
- Refrigerate
Sesame Chicken:
- 1 pound chicken, bite-size
- 3 tablespoons cornstarch
- salt
- 2 tablespoons oil
- 3 tablespoons soy sauce
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
- 2 cloves garlic
- 1 teaspoon sesame oil
- sesame seeds

- Toss the chicken with cornstarch and salt
- Cook in the oil until browned and cooked through
- Simmer the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, and garlic until glossy
- Toss the chicken in the sauce. Finish with sesame oil and sesame seeds
Sourdough Bread:
- 1/2 cup active starter
- 1 1/2 cups water
- 4 cups flour
- 2 teaspoons salt

Baked
- Mix the starter, water, and flour. Rest 30 minutes
- Add the salt. Fold the dough every 30 minutes for 2 hours
- Rise until puffy, about 4–8 hours
- Shape, then refrigerate overnight
- Oven: 450 degrees, in a covered pot
- Time: 20 minutes covered, then 20–25 minutes uncovered
Sourdough Brioche:
- 1/2 cup active starter
- 1/3 cup milk
- 3 eggs
- 1/4 cup sugar
- 3 cups flour
- 1 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup soft butter

Baked
- Mix everything except the butter. Knead in the butter a little at a time
- Rise until doubled, 4–8 hours
- Shape into a loaf. Rise until puffy
- Oven: 350 degrees
- Time: 30–35 minutes
Stuffing:
- 1 loaf bread, cubed and dried
- 1/2 cup butter
- 1 onion, chopped
- 3 ribs celery, chopped
- 2 teaspoons sage
- 1 teaspoon thyme
- 2 cups broth
- salt and pepper

Baked
- Cook the onion and celery in the butter. Stir in the herbs
- Toss with the bread and broth
- Oven: 375 degrees
- Time: 30–35 minutes, until browned
Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos (Vegan:
- 2 sweet potatoes, cubed
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 teaspoon chili powder
- salt
- 1 can black beans, drained
- 8 tortillas
- cabbage, lime, and avocado

Baked
- Toss the sweet potatoes with oil, chili powder, and salt
- Oven: 425 degrees
- Time: 25 minutes
- Warm the beans
- Fill the tortillas with the potatoes, beans, cabbage, lime, and avocado
Sweet Potato Burrito Bowl (Vegan):
- 2 sweet potatoes, cubed
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 teaspoon cumin
- salt
- 2 cups cooked rice
- 1 can black beans, drained
- salsa
- lime

Baked
- Toss the sweet potatoes with oil, cumin, and salt
- Oven: 425 degrees
- Time: 25 minutes
- Bowl the rice, beans, and sweet potatoes
- Top with salsa and lime
Taqueria Style Pickled Jalapeños:
- 8 jalapeños, sliced
- 1/2 onion, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 cup vinegar
- 1 cup water
- 1 tablespoon salt
- 1 teaspoon oregano
- 1 tablespoon oil

- Sear the jalapeños in the oil
- Add the onion, carrot, vinegar, water, salt, and oregano
- Simmer 5 minutes
- Cool and refrigerate
Tater Tots:
- 2 large potatoes
- 1 teaspoon salt
- 1 tablespoon oil

Baked
- Grate the potatoes and squeeze out the water
- Toss with salt and oil. Form into tots
- Oven: 425 degrees
- Time: 20–25 minutes, flip halfway
Yellow Mustard:
- 1/2 cup mustard powder
- 1/2 cup water
- 1/4 cup vinegar
- 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1 teaspoon honey, optional

- Stir the mustard powder and water. Rest 10 minutes
- Add the vinegar, turmeric, salt, and honey
- Simmer a few minutes until thick
- Cool. It mellows in the fridge
Mexican Ground Beef Casserole:
- 1 pound ground beef
- 1 packet taco seasoning
- 1 can enchilada sauce
- 8 corn tortillas
- 2 cups shredded cheese

Baked
- Brown the beef. Stir in the seasoning and half the sauce
- Layer the tortillas, beef, and cheese in a greased dish
- Pour the rest of the sauce over the top and add the remaining cheese
- Oven: 350 degrees
- Time: 20–25 minutes
Potato Salad:
- 2 pounds potatoes, cubed
- 4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped
- 1/2 cup mayonnaise
- 1 tablespoon yellow mustard
- 2 ribs celery, diced
- 1/4 cup diced onion or pickles
- salt and pepper

- Boil the potatoes until tender. Cool
- Stir in the eggs, mayonnaise, mustard, celery, onion, salt, and pepper
- Chill
Salsa Verde Fresca:
- 1 pound tomatillos, husked
- 1 jalapeño
- 1/2 onion
- 2 cloves garlic
- 1 cup cilantro
- juice of 1 lime
- salt

- Boil or roast the tomatillos and jalapeño until soft
- Blend with the onion, garlic, cilantro, lime, and salt
Restaurant-Style Egg Fried Rice:
- 3 cups cold cooked rice
- 2 eggs
- 2 tablespoons oil
- 1 cup frozen peas and carrots
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce
- 1 teaspoon sesame oil
- 2 scallions

- Scramble the eggs in a hot wok and set them aside
- Stir-fry the vegetables, then the rice, until hot
- Add the eggs, soy sauce, sesame oil, and scallions
